performance.verdict: Spend is live but leads are invisible — a CRM integration failure, not an ads failure.

findings.text: Zero leads recorded in GHL across all 28 days despite $927.81 in Google Ads spend and 10 platform-reported conversions — CRM intake is broken, not ads.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completed event — 30 days overdue, blocking speed-to-lead validation.
Intake ownership is unresolved since Vivian left 7/7 — speed-to-lead automations point at an empty seat, confirmed by 0 GHL appointments in 28 days.
GBP actions fell 64.1% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 27–29) show 3, 0, 0 actions — a confirmed 3-day signal of declining local organic engagement.
Google spend is erratic — single-day spikes of $130.18 (Aug 15) and $122.82 (Aug 9) alongside $0 days suggest campaign pacing or budget cap instability, not deliberate throttle.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL–Google Ads webhook/integration immediately; 10 platform conversions vs 0 CRM leads confirms a broken data pipe.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reported 10 conversions over 28 days but zero contacts arrived in GHL, confirmed by 0 appointments logged. The immediate action is to audit the GHL webhook or Zapier/API connection receiving Google Ads conversion events, and confirm who owns the GHL seat following Vivian's departure on 7/7. Success is defined as at least 1 verified lead flowing end-to-end from ad click to GHL contact record. This must be resolved before 2026-09-03 — budgets cannot be scaled while intake is broken.

suggestions.text: Complete overdue booking bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31); assign named owner and confirm after-hours coverage path.
suggestions.monday_update: The booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and has no completed event recorded — it is now 30 days overdue. Assign a named owner (coordinate with Xavier or Aiman per client contacts), run a full end-to-end test including after-hours scenario, and log the result. Success check: documented pass/fail record in the SOW sheet by 2026-09-06. This is a prerequisite for the scale-back-up gate.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP action trend: 3-day signal is 3→0→0 actions; re-check 2026-09-03 before any organic intervention.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 64.1% week-over-week and the last 3 days (Aug 27–29) show 3, 0, 0 actions — a confirmed short-term signal. No action is warranted yet as this may reflect weekend seasonality or the known Windsor data lag flagged in the SOW for end-of-window dates. Re-check on 2026-09-03; if the 3-day average remains below 2 actions/day, escalate to a GBP content or Q&A refresh.
